correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the explicit-formula terms and all parameter restrictions from RESULT.md. The weighted gamma contribution after Stirling is hatphi(0)(1+(2log2-1-log(2pi))/logT)+o(1/logT) because off-critical |zeta|² averaging gives uniformly weighted log t with ∫_1²logu du=2log2-1. Source-stated I_q/I_sigma moment expansion for q≤T^alpha gives summed prime-power errors O(T^{1-2sigma+alpha(sigma-1/2)}/L), O(T^{-sigma+3alpha/2}L), O(T^{-sigma/2+alpha(sigma+1/2)}L); all o(1/L) for alpha<sigma/(2sigma+1). The full von Mangoldt series converges absolutely at s=sigma+1/2>1, and its sum is -zeta'(s)/zeta(s), yielding plus 2*zeta'/zeta in coefficient. Laurent behavior at s=1 gives pole -2/(sigma-1/2). Numerical prime cutoffs are not used as proof. Important source-access qualification: Theorem 2.4 exact moment estimate and pole-term normalization from the new primary paper could not be independently cross-read in full, so this is a conditional reconstruction against the correctly quoted source estimate, not external verification of that estimate.
